questions.q: Let $A$ be the matrix with rows $\langle1,3\rangle$ and $\langle-2,4\rangle$, and $B$ be the matrix with rows $\langle2,-1\rangle$ and $\langle0,5\rangle$. Find $A+B$ and $2A$.
questions.answer: $A+B$ has rows $\langle3,2\rangle$ and $\langle-2,9\rangle$. $2A$ has rows $\langle2,6\rangle$ and $\langle-4,8\rangle$.
$AB$ has rows $\langle2,14\rangle$ and $\langle-4,22\rangle$: e.g. row $1$, column $1$ is $(1)(2)+(3)(0)=2$.

questions.q: Let $A$ have rows $\langle1,3\rangle$ and $\langle-2,4\rangle$, and let $\mathbf{v}=\langle3,-1\rangle$. Find $A\mathbf{v}$.
Find $\det A$ for the matrix $A$ with rows $\langle1,3\rangle$ and $\langle-2,4\rangle$, and state whether $A$ is invertible.
Find $A^{-1}$ for the matrix $A$ with rows $\langle1,3\rangle$ and $\langle-2,4\rangle$.
questions.answer: $A^{-1}=\dfrac{1}{10}\times$ the matrix with rows $\langle4,-3\rangle$ and $\langle2,1\rangle$, i.e., $A^{-1}$ has rows $\langle0.4,-0.3\rangle$ and $\langle0.2,0.1\rangle$.

sections.heading: Solving systems with the inverse matrix

questions.q: Solve the system $x+3y=13$ and $-2x+4y=4$ using $\mathbf{x}=A^{-1}\mathbf{b}$ (using $A^{-1}$ from above).
Find the angle between $\langle7,1\rangle$ and $\langle2,-3\rangle$, rounded to the nearest tenth of a degree.
